description: This Kotlin source file defines a network monitor using Android's ConnectivityManager. It provides a Flow<Boolean> that emits the online/offline status based on network connectivity changes, leveraging NetworkCallback and coroutine flows.

classes.name: ConnectivityManagerNetworkMonitor
classes.description: An internal class that monitors network connectivity status and exposes it as a Flow<Boolean>.
